proposed_widenings.name: passive_trait (ClassFeatureMechanics family)
proposed_widenings.justification: Use Magic Device grants three always-on benefits with no activation cost, no use count, and no rest reset cadence. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family ('activation') mandates activationCost, resource, and resetCadence. A passive_trait family is required to represent always-on class feature benefits that trigger automatically or are unconditionally active.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You've learned how to maximize use of magic items, granting you the following benefits. — no activation trigger, no uses per rest, no cost stated anywhere in the feature.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_attunement_cap
proposed_widenings.justification: The Attunement benefit extends the character's attunement slot count from 3 to 4. No existing ClassFeatureEffect or v4 effect atom covers a numeric change to the attunement capacity. The v4 atom 'attunement_slot' is a consumed resource, not a cap modifier.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can attune to up to four magic items at once.

proposed_widenings.name: charge_refund_on_roll
proposed_widenings.justification: The Charges benefit introduces a stochastic 'roll 1d6, on 6 do not expend charges' mechanic triggered on each magic item charge expenditure. v4 has 'refund' as a procedure atom but no surface shape for a probabilistic die-gated charge refund. This is mechanically distinct from any existing effect, window, or resource atom — it requires a die-roll gate concept with no current representation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you use a magic item property that expends charges, roll 1d6. On a roll of 6, you use the property without expending the charges.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_scroll_access
proposed_widenings.justification: The Scrolls benefit unlocks use of any Spell Scroll with Intelligence as spellcasting ability, plus a level-scaled DC ability check for higher-level scrolls (DC 10 + spell level) and item destruction on failure. v4 has 'grant_spell_access' for class spell list expansion, but no atom covers 'use a physical magic item (scroll) as a spell source with a custom casting ability, gated on a level-dependent ability check, with item destruction on failure'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can use any Spell Scroll, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability... If the scroll contains a higher-level spell, you must first succeed on an Intelligence (Arcana) check (DC 10 plus the spell's level). On a failed check, the scroll disintegrates.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: the ClassFeatureMechanics union has only one family ('activation'), which mandates activationCost + resource + resetCadence. Use Magic Device is entirely passive — no activation, no use count, no rest refill. This alone prevents honest encoding. Even if a passive_trait family were added, three new atoms would be needed for the sub-mechanics: modify_attunement_cap (Attunement), charge_refund_on_roll (Charges), and grant_scroll_access (Scrolls).
